# Lumen: Free SaaS Landing Page Template

> Lumen is a free, MIT-licensed HTML landing page template for SaaS, AI and developer-tool products, made by Vantle (independent design and development studio, https://vantle.studio). Dark "Ember" design for a fictional AI inference cloud, with one persistent scroll-driven Three.js scene (liquid chrome core, glass ring, 11k particles morphing halo -> globe -> GPU fabric), GSAP ScrollTrigger + SplitText, Lenis smooth scroll, a bento grid of live mini UIs, console mockup, pricing and FAQ. No build step.

## Use
- Live demo: https://middlesugar7000.github.io/lumen-saas-landing-page-template/
- Source: https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/lumen-saas-landing-page-template
- Start: serve the folder (npx serve . or python -m http.server); the 3D scene is an ES module
- Customize: CSS variables on :root in css/style.css; copy in index.html; 3D scene in js/scene.js; motion and mini UIs in js/main.js

## Author
- Vantle is an independent design and development studio: brand and identity, web design and 3D, full-stack SaaS, APIs and AI features. Focused landing pages usually take 2 to 4 weeks, complete SaaS builds 6 to 12.
- Contact: https://vantle.studio/#start or hello@vantle.studio (reply within one business day)
